description.$value: Link colors of the brand mode ZH. The plain names are for light surfaces, the names with _inverse for dark surfaces. The link tokens point here, so the brand decides the link colors.

default.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, light surfaces. ZH: zh.ch text link (grey, black on hover).

default_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, dark surfaces. ZH: white, as zh.ch shows links on dark backgrounds.

hover.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, light surfaces. ZH: zh.ch text link (grey, black on hover).

hover_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, dark surfaces. ZH: white, as zh.ch shows links on dark backgrounds.

active.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, light surfaces. ZH: zh.ch text link (grey, black on hover).

active_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, dark surfaces. ZH: white, as zh.ch shows links on dark backgrounds.

visited.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, visited, light surfaces. ZH: same as default, zh.ch does not style visited links.

visited_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, visited, dark surfaces. ZH: same as default, zh.ch does not style visited links.

default_max.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, light surfaces, high contrast: #666666 mixed 50% with black.

default_max_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, dark surfaces, high contrast: #FFFFFF mixed 50% with white.

hover_max.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, light surfaces, high contrast: #000000 mixed 50% with black.

hover_max_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, dark surfaces, high contrast: #FFFFFF mixed 50% with white.

active_max.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, light surfaces, high contrast: #000000 mixed 50% with black.

active_max_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, dark surfaces, high contrast: #FFFFFF mixed 50% with white.

visited_max.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, visited, light surfaces, high contrast: #666666 mixed 50% with black.

visited_max_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, visited, dark surfaces, high contrast: #FFFFFF mixed 50% with white.
